title: But Soon!, Bassoon
program_note: In line with (but predating) the Miniatures series, But Soon!, Bassoon is a three-movement work for two bassoons which was inspired by and exploits the unique sonic and technical capabilities of the bassoon, from bouncy lower registers to lyric upper registers, and a panoply of extended techniques (including multiphonics, reed and non-reed sounds, and many others).
